## Change / 改动

Describe the trigger, previous behavior and new behavior. / 说明触发条件及修改前后的行为。

## Validation / 验证

List checks actually run and their results. Explain any untested behavior.
列出实际运行的检查及结果，说明未验证的部分。

## Compatibility and safety / 兼容性与安全

- [ ] CLI/config/JSON changes and migration steps documented / 已说明接口、配置变更与迁移
- [ ] No candidate data, credentials, browser state or real submissions / 无个人数据、密钥、浏览器状态或真实投递
- [ ] Relevant regression coverage for changed behavior / 行为变更有必要的回归覆盖
- [ ] AI feedback assessed; another contributor must approve / 已评估 AI 意见，仍需另一位贡献者批准
